title: docs(pm-dispatch): point every PR-body rewrite at the issue_patch door
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xRZfRWwVbM1oLGd4rdqg3kL)_

Fixes #31050

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

`dispatch-gates --tier` reads a MANDATORY model tier, from clause ① (`.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, the dev-agent definition). This card ran on the project's default model: that mandate is waived by the maintainer's standing order in this project (2026-11-03), and the dispatching seat runs the contract review.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:席位改写 PR 正文的其余三处(`rest-channel.md`、`platform-readings.md` 的 flake 记因、`os-dev.md` 的席位代写)都指向 `seat-post-protocol.md` 的 PR 正文行;中继改 PR 正文不追加页脚这一读数补进 `platform-readings.md`;`check-handover.mjs` 头注分别点名交回规则的两处去处。
- 为什么改:#31049 只在两处教了 PR 正文门;`rest-channel.md` 仍写「直调 `dispatch.mjs` 仅落地」,与 ACCEPT 前改正文相抵,另两处改正文不点门。
- 风险与回滚:只改内部 agent 规程文字与一行脚本注释,不发包(`skip-changeset`),四个文件行数不变;回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`rest-channel.md` L16–17(新例外行);`platform-readings.md` L343(新页脚读数,排在 L337–342 的裸 REST 改侧格之后)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`,预期退出 0,`rest-channel.md` 82 行、`platform-readings.md` 458 行、`os-dev.md` 405 行,各等于上限。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**Item 1, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/rest-channel.md` L16.** The line said a direct `dispatch.mjs` call is for landing only, but a seat rewrites a PR body before ACCEPT. It is split in two:

- L16 keeps the op table, the read side and the batch rule: `闭合 op 表住 fleet-write/ops.mjs;读侧不走中继;批量恒走逐 op 工具。`
- New L17 names the exception and points to the door, with no second spelling of it: `直调 dispatch.mjs 仅落地,与 PR 正文单笔 issue_patch(seat-post-protocol.md 正文行,不送页脚)。`

**Item 2, `scripts/pm/check-handover.mjs` L33–34 (header comment only, no code).** PR #31049 deleted the old home (`seat-post-protocol.md`, 收班), and its two facts now live in two places, so the header names both:

- the refusal inside (a), a `needs_decision` card handed to the decision box and never back to `pm:queue` → `seat-post-protocol.md` 交接收尾清单 step 2 (L47, `needs_decision 进决策箱`);
- the stay-behind narrowing → `seat-lifecycle.md` 离任留守 (L44, 离任留守只写点名的已 ACCEPT 待队列或待人批 PR).

The comment now reads: `The sign-off hand-back rule (seat-post-protocol.md, 交接收尾清单 step 2) names one refusal inside (a); seat-lifecycle.md 离任留守 narrows (a)'s stay-behind (section below):`.

**Item 3, the two rewrites that named no door.**

- `references/platform-readings.md` L290 (new, under the `Check Changeset` flake line): `⇒ 该正文改走 seat-post-protocol.md 的 PR 正文行,不送页脚。`
- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` L66, rewritten in place: `PR 正文 dev 只在 pr_create 写,⛔ 不 PATCH;改法报告点名,席位经 seat-post-protocol.md 代写。` The meaning is the old line's (the dev writes the body once, at the create; the report names the change; the seat writes it), and it now names where the seat's rewrite goes.

**Item 4, the footer reading (`platform-readings.md` L336–341).** Settled from code and stored bodies only; no test write was made.

- How the relay reads back: after a `success` run, `sendFleetWrite` reads every action that sent a `body` (`READ_BACK_LOCATORS.issue_patch` = `GET /repos/{repo}/issues/{issue}`) and judges it with post-stamped's `classifyReadBack` (`judgeStoredBody`, `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` L1081). The class `identical` is `stored === sent` (`declaredNormalisation`, `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` L2843). Nothing is stripped before that comparison, and `storedBytes` is the raw stored length. A stored body with the bare footer appended would print `footer-appended`, not `identical`.
- What it read: PR #31049's body, 8149 bytes sent and 8149 stored, `identical`. PR #29225's edit was read back `identical` too (its landing comment on #29145).
- What the stored bodies show today (one `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/{n}` each, read only): #31049 is 8149 bytes and #29225 is 6785 bytes, and both end with the `<!-- signed: … -->` trailer and a newline. Neither carries a `_Generated by …_` footer.
- So the relay `issue_patch` appends no footer, while main L338–341 measured the raw-REST `PATCH` cell (+58). Per AGENTS.md, the cells differ by channel and are not generalised. Main L341 (now L340) stays as it is. New L343 records the relay cell after the whole raw-REST edit-side band (L337–342), so the strip-both-spellings and attribution lines still read with their own cell: `中继 issue_patch 不在此列:dispatch.mjs 读回 PR 正文存 = 送(identical),无追加。`
- `seat-post-protocol.md` L31 is unchanged. Adding 不送页脚 there does not fit at 120 B (the shortest spelling measured is 125 B), and the file has no restatement to delete to pay for a second line. For now the no-footer word rides on the pointers: `rest-channel.md` L17 and `platform-readings.md` L290 carry it, and `SKILL.md` L313 already did. `os-dev.md` L66 is at exactly 120 B and carries the pointer only. Giving the rule its one home at L31 (and dropping the pointers' copies) is left to #31059.

### Deleted restatements (deletion only; each fact's surviving home)

| File | Deleted line (main) | Surviving home |
|---|---|---|
| `rest-channel.md` | L42 `⛔ post-stamped/label-write 永不接进管道再 &&:拒收读成 0;看尾先落文件或 set -o pipefail。` | `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` header, 〈⛔ Never pipe this tool, then `&&` the write that follows〉 (L112–127: redirect then capture, or `set -o pipefail`; "it covers every writer beside it — `label-write.mjs` included"); `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` header, 〈Exit codes — capture them BEFORE any pipe〉 (L156) |
| `platform-readings.md` | L36 `⛔ 永不用 -c merge.os-regen.driver= 覆盖:驱动不是被关掉而是跑失败,路由路径全报冲突。` | AGENTS.md, Multi-agent discipline §11, corollary ("⛔ Never with `-c merge.os-regen.driver=` … git runs the configured program, it fails, and every routed path is reported conflicted"); `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` header L303–304 |
| `platform-readings.md` | L313 `否则 repair-first 被正确地应用到完好的卡上,重写毁掉的是正确内容。` | AGENTS.md, 〈GitHub mutates body BYTES〉 ("⛔ A body reading short only through the API is probably intact — check the rendered page before "repairing" it; a rewrite destroys a correct card"); the prescription it followed, L312 (now L311), stays |

## Tests

None: the diff is instruction text and one comment line, with no runtime behaviour to test. The gates below are the checks.

## Acceptance notes

### Line budget (`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, exit 0)

| File | Lines (main → head) | Ceiling | Bytes (main → head) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `references/rest-channel.md` | 82 → 82 | 82 | 7,772 → 7,739 |
| `references/platform-readings.md` | 458 → 458 | 458 | 47,066 → 47,039 |
| `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` | 405 → 405 | 405 | 38,411 → 38,414 |
| `scripts/pm/check-handover.mjs` (not ratcheted) | 891 → 891 | — | 65,299 → 65,301 |

Every touched line: `rest-channel.md` L16 120 → 88 B, new L17 118 B; `platform-readings.md` new L290 78 B, new L343 102 B; `os-dev.md` L66 117 → 120 B; `check-handover.mjs` L33 111 → 113 B and L34 31 → 78 B. No new section; no fence line touched.

### Not changed here (found while reading)

- `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` header (〈A pull request's body …〉, L454–456 on `main`) still says "an edit of a pull's body gets the bare footer block appended after the trailer (`platform-readings.md`, the edit side), so send no footer of your own". The relay read-backs above show no append on that path. The advice (send no footer) still holds: a footer after the trailer would be the body's last non-empty line, and the door would refuse the body as unsigned. Only the stated reason is stale. This is outside the card's file surface; it is filed as #31059 and not changed here.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local gates on 3ac60838: 41 derived, 41 run with exit 0, 0 NOT MEASURED (`dispatch-gates --ran`)</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived the same 41 commands for the 4 changed paths as on round 1 (33bac6af). Each ran under a 900 s timeout, its exit code captured before any pipe; all 41 exited 0 on the first run (the `@objectstack/formula`, `@objectstack/lint` and `@objectstack/objectql` builds from round 1 were in place).
- They include `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:pm-governed-prose`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:pm-half-states`, `check:pm-post-stamped`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:commit-card-trailers`, `check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs`, and the self-tests of `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` and `check-harness-current.mjs`.
- `--ran` printed: `41 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 41 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 41 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`.
- Round 1 (33bac6af): 41 of 41 exit 0, the formula gate after the same builds.

</details>

- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/project-thread-0ili91`: GOVERNED, Tier S (席内达档复核落地): `.claude/**` ×3; `scripts/pm/check-handover.mjs` is not on the register; 14 changed lines (+7 / −7), under 3000.
- `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD`: exit 0 before every push.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No schema touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (No names added.)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran. (Markdown and one comment line; no lintable source changed.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. Nothing publishes (`.claude/**` and a `scripts/pm/**` comment), so the PR takes `skip-changeset`. Both declaration lines are filled in above.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` not touched; nothing to regenerate.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (The 维护者速读 section is Chinese, per the lane template.)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
